author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: Qualys VMDR has no push for detections, so this parser reads the records the example bridge in bridges/qualys-vmdr-detections pulls from the Host List Detection API (v6.0) and posts to HTTP Ingest: one JSON record per detection, with "qualys_record" first, the host's XML elements under HOST, the detection's under DETECTION and the QID's KnowledgeBase entry under KB. Give the bridge a Qualys user with the Reader role and API access, scoped to the asset groups it should read. The bridge sends a detection each time its status changes (New, Active, Re-Opened or Fixed). Sophos Fusion has no vulnerability schema for custom parsers (its Tenable integration fills the Vulnerabilities tab of a detection, which a custom parser can't write), so each detection goes to Thirdparty, the schema the Sophos Fusion schema list gives alerts from sources outside Sophos Fusion: the KnowledgeBase title as the title (QID and number when the bridge runs with QUALYS_KB=0), the scan's results as the summary, the unique vulnerability ID as alert_id, the status, the detection type (Confirmed, Potential or Info) as confidence, the Qualys category, severity 1 to 5 as info, low, medium, high and critical, the Qualys Detection Score as risk_score, the host's address, name, port and protocol as the target, and the first found, last found, update and fixed times. The event time is when the status last changed. The QID, the host and asset IDs, OS, FQDN, NetBIOS name, CVEs, CVSS scores, threat indicators and the API server go to additional_data. Samples are made up in the shapes of Qualys's Host List Detection output DTD and KnowledgeBase examples, as the bridge turns them into JSON; the API server in qualys_platform is written under example.com because the repo's sample scan blocks other host names. Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-22 (110 of 110 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs). No built-in parser claimed these records.
